properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities, with one thing worth saying plainly: this capability is realized by prose and diagrams, not code, so "verification" here means someone who did not build reflow2 reading the README and successfully running it. That is a trial, not a test suite — which is the same reason the 33-capability validation gap is dispositioned to the trials programme. It arrives with BL-102, and the honest check is a person, not a CI job.
